name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (anim/walk domain, descriptor 'step_left'). 'left' is a semantic walk direction (matches siblings down/left/up/right), not an ID to strip. No Ghidra address residue. Caller fd2_walk_path_animation_loop maps path-byte 1 -> this function, and body sets facing=1 (west) and decrements pos_x, confirming LEFT/west semantics.
purpose: Render a 6-frame animated walk step LEFT (west, -1 x tile) for runtime character char_idx, scrolling the battle viewport one column left when the character is near the left edge and the window can still retreat.
logic_summary: Caches pos_x (pChar[0]), sets facing pChar[3]=1 (west), seeds walk_anim_x_scroll_offset=6. Scroll decision: if char's on-screen column < 2 AND view_window_origin_x != 0, set per-frame scroll_delta_x=-4 and scroll_window_flag=-1 (viewport will retreat 1 col); else just decrement cursor_screen_x (no scroll). 6-frame slide loop: tick tutorial/sfx + palette-cycle anim, set walk_anim_phase pChar[4]=frame, tick chapter palette anim, set left-edge clip marker=0x18, accumulate the Y sub-pixel offset and X scroll offset by the per-frame deltas, composite the 14-col-wide battle tile map (origin_x-1, +1 left margin), clear clip marker, composite character overlay, advance blit_offset by scroll_delta_x, blit the rectangle to VRAM 0xA0504, wait one BIOS tick. Finalize: pos_x--, view_window_origin_x += scroll_window_flag, cursor_world_x--, clear walk_anim_phase, clear Y sub-pixel offset and X scroll offset, then call fd2_check_tile_event_post_action(cursor_world_x, cursor_world_y, 0).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the moving runtime character into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (entry stride RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE). Passed straight through from fd2_walk_path_animation_loop and forwarded to fd2_tick_tutorial_progress_with_sfx each frame.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime character array index; no address residue, not a generic param_N. Matches usage in all sibling walk_step_* functions.

returns.semantics: No return value; mutates runtime char position/facing/anim-phase, viewport origin, cursor world/screen coords, and renders frames to VRAM.

notes: Source comment block (aniwalk.c lines 125-131) is already concise and accurate (6-frame walk LEFT, facing=1 west, -1 x, viewport scroll, shared epilogue with walk_step_down) and parallel with sibling step functions, so kept as-is. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the implementation -> not modified. runtime_char field semantics cross-checked against fd2-knowledge struct runtime_char (guide base+0x08: x,y,graphic,direction,running-action -> here pChar[0]=pos_x, pChar[1]=pos_y, pChar[3]=facing/direction, pChar[4]=walk_anim_phase/running-action); facing=1 for west is consistent with siblings (down=0,left=1,up=2,right=3).
